parameters.name: IsHistory
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the historical tasks. Valid values:

*   **0**: returns the current task.
*   **1**: returns the historical tasks.

Default value: **0**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-pending-maintenance-actions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-history 1 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
